Informatively, The Competent Authority has appointed one Independent Director on the Board of SCILAL w.e.f. 15.04.2025.
Pursuant to Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Letter no. SS 11025/1/2024-SU dated 28.07.2025, MoPSW has conveyed that Shri Venkatesapathy S., Joint Secretary (Shipping), MoPSW, as Government Director on the Board of SCILAL and Shri Rajesh Kumar Sinha, Special Secretary, MoPSW, who was holding the position of Government Nominee Director on the Board of SCILAL, has ceased to hold the position of the Director on the Board of SCILAL with effect from 28.07.2025.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: The Competent Authority appointed an Independent Director to the Board of SCILAL effective from 15.04.2025. Consequently, all statutory committees, including the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and Risk Management Committee, were constituted with effect from 15.04.2025. Following the appointment of Capt Som Raj as Director (Operations) from 15.07.2025, the Audit Committee, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee were reconstituted to include Capt Som Raj as a member from 15.07.2025. Concurrently, Shri Rajesh Kumar Sinha ceased to be a member of these committees from the 15.07.2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnCommitteeTe: Pursuant to Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways Letter no. SS 11025/1/2024-SU dated 28.07.2025, MoPSW has conveyed that Shri Rajesh Kumar Sinha, Special Secretary, MoPSW, who was holding the position of Government Nominee Director on the Board of SCILAL, has ceased to hold the position of the Director on the Board of SCILAL with effect from 28.07.2025 and has consequently ceased to be a member of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Venkatesapathy S. was appointed as Government Nominee Director w.e.f 28.07.2025 and was thus inducted as member of this committee from said date.

As defined by the Board of Directors, the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is a member of the Risk Management Committee (RMC). Accordingly, Ms. Laxmi Kamath, who currently holds the position of CFO, is a member of the RMC. Since she is not a Director of the Company, her DIN is not available.
Capt Som Raj was appointed as Director (Operations) from 15.07.2025 and was thus inducted as member of this committee from the said date.
